turns.question: What was our refund rate by value on the orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no value-based refund rate: the only rate is the return rate, which is by count (returns over orders, both counted on the day the order was placed), and it was 10 % (3 returns out of 30 orders) for orders placed 1-2 October 2026. The closest value metrics are Returns (EUR) and Revenue (EUR), but they are not combined into a ratio and Returns (EUR) is counted on the return date, so I give no value-based percentage. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
